sections.title: Accepting these terms
paragraphs: By creating a Link2Build partner account you agree to these terms and to the policies referenced inside them.
We may update these terms; the version shown here is always the one that applies to you.

sections.title: Your obligations
paragraphs: You are responsible for the accuracy of the documents, machines and operators you register on the platform.

subsections.title: You must not
bullets: Register a machine or operator you are not authorised to offer
Ask a customer to settle a booking outside the platform
Share your account or OTP with anyone else

sections.title: Payments and deductions
paragraphs: Platform fees and any applicable deductions are shown on every booking before you accept it.
Payouts are settled to the bank account verified during onboarding.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: We may suspend an account that repeatedly cancels confirmed jobs, submits false documents, or puts customers or operators at risk.
